meta.disclaimer: Event dates can shift annually. Confirm exact dates and ticket availability with local tourism offices before booking travel.

events.name: Cape Town Minstrel Carnival
events.description: Colourful street parade celebrating Cape Malay and coloured community heritage — one of the city's liveliest New Year traditions.

events.name: Knysna Oyster Festival
events.description: Ten days of seafood, forest runs, and waterfront festivities on the Garden Route lagoon.

events.name: Kirstenbosch Summer Sunset Concerts
events.description: Open-air concerts at the foot of Table Mountain — bring a picnic blanket and enjoy South African artists at golden hour.

events.name: Southern Right Whale Season
events.description: Land-based whale watching at its finest — mothers and calves breach metres from the cliff-path.

events.name: Windhoek Karneval
events.description: German-influenced carnival with parades, beer tents, and costumes — a Windhoek social highlight since colonial times.

events.name: Etosha Dry-Season Wildlife Peak
events.description: Wildlife concentrates at waterholes as the pan dries — peak self-drive safari season with excellent predator sightings.

events.name: Sossusvlei Photography Season
events.description: Cooler mornings and crisp light on the red dunes — arrive before sunrise for Dune 45 and Deadvlei.

events.name: Okavango Flood Arrival
events.description: Floodwaters from Angola transform the delta — mokoro season peaks as channels fill and wildlife islands shrink.

events.name: Chobe River Safari Season
events.description: Elephant herds along the Chobe Riverfront — afternoon boat cruises offer spectacular close-range viewing.

events.name: Victoria Falls High Water
events.description: Maximum spray and thunder — the Falls are at their most dramatic though visibility from the gorge can be misty.

events.name: Devil's Pool Season (Zambia side)
events.description: Swim at the lip of the Falls on a guided Livingstone Island trip — only when water levels are safe.

events.name: South Luangwa Emerald Season
events.description: Lush green bush, newborn animals, and dramatic skies — fewer visitors and excellent birding.

events.name: Victoria Falls Low Water (Zimbabwe views)
events.description: Clearest views into the basalt gorge — ideal for photography and white-water rafting below the Falls.

events.name: Harare International Festival of the Arts
events.description: Southern Africa's leading multidisciplinary arts festival — theatre, music, dance, and visual arts across the capital.

events.name: Maputo International Jazz Festival
events.description: Afro-jazz and international acts in the capital — Mozambique's coastal rhythm meets global stages.

events.name: Tofo Whale Shark Season
events.description: Snorkel with whale sharks and manta rays in the Indian Ocean — one of Africa's best marine megafauna encounters.

events.name: Bazaruto Diving Season
events.description: Calm seas and excellent visibility for dugong, turtle, and reef diving around the archipelago.

events.name: Lake of Stars Festival
events.description: Beachside music and arts festival on the lakeshore — Malawi's flagship international cultural event.

events.name: Liwonde Dry-Season Boating
events.description: Shire River boat safaris peak as water levels drop — elephants, hippos, and African skimmers at close range.

events.name: Nyika Wildflower Season
events.description: Rolling montane grasslands carpeted with orchids and wildflowers after the rains.

events.name: Sani Pass Snow Season
events.description: Dramatic snow on Africa's highest pass — 4x4 essential; Afriski and Oxbow offer winter sports nearby.

events.name: Malealea Pony Trekking Season
events.description: Multi-day Basotho pony treks through mountain villages — best when passes are clear of snow.

events.name: Morija Arts & Cultural Festival
events.description: Lesotho's premier arts gathering — music, theatre, and Basotho heritage in the historic mission town.

events.name: Umhlanga Reed Dance
events.description: Eswatini's most famous cultural ceremony — tens of thousands of women present reeds to the Queen Mother.

events.name: Bushfire Festival
events.description: Three-day music and arts festival at House on Fire — Southern Africa's boutique festival with a social conscience.

events.name: Hlane Dry-Season Game Viewing
events.description: Lions, rhinos, and vultures in lowveld bush — guided drives when vegetation is thin and wildlife visible.

events.name: KAZA Victoria Falls Circuit
events.description: UniVisa links Zambia, Zimbabwe, and Chobe day trips — the classic multi-country Falls itinerary any month.

events.name: Kruger Dry-Season Safari
events.description: Sparse bush and reliable waterhole action — peak Big Five viewing for self-drivers and first-timers.

events.name: Chobe–Caprivi Elephant Corridors
events.description: Large elephant herds move between Botswana and Namibia's riverfront — combine with Chobe day trips.
